title: Compare arbitrary time windows — cd_compare
text: Defaults compare recent decade (2015:2025) WMO-style standard normal reference period (1951:1980) — framing used package vignettes. cumulative-impact comparison ("much warmer recent decade pre-warming reference?") rather rate--change comparison; latter use cd_trend(). window-vs-window p-value (test = "t" Welch t-test test = "wilcox" Mann-Whitney U) tests whether means two windows differ — different question cd_trend()'s Mann-Kendall test, checks monotonic trend across full series.
